findings.reason: the node's promotion-side read has no existing caller to parallel and §18 names none, so an implementer either builds a refusal whose stated premise is false or discovers mid-build that the text half the sentence leans on does not exist.
findings.text: §18 asserts "A blocking figure finding refuses `crew complete` as a blocking text finding does", but no promotion check reads a finding's severity: `BLOCKING_FINDING_SEVERITY` and `blocking_findings` are referenced only from `reckon/crew/repair.py` and `reckon/crew/review.py`, and every review refusal in `reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py` keys on the stored record's `status`/head alone (`reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:939`, `not (review and review.get("status") == "parsed")`), so a store holding a blocking finding still satisfies the gate; `review_lifecycle.is_hot`, which does read severities, is called only from `reckon/crew/routing.py` and `reckon/crew/obligations.py`, never from the promotion path

findings.reason: this finding is not the previously declined one about the gate's href, since it was §6's own change that retired the symbol, so the gate's closed verdict now evidences a mechanism §6 no longer implements, and a node reading §6's gate learns the wrong capability.
findings.text: the §6 gate `g-ssp-figure-lane` still names `select_profile_backend` in its measure ("a figure profile dispatched to a backend that declares none is refused by name") and in its evidence text, but that symbol exists nowhere in the tree (`grep -rn select_profile_backend reckon/` returns nothing); §6's rewrite records the retirement and routes through `_review_lane_candidates(config, profile="figure")` (`reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1442`, whose `profile` filter is `reckon/flight.py:1935` `"figure": ("image",)`), and where the retired resolver refused per lane, §6 now holds the review when no lane declares image input

findings.reason: §6's first done-when case asserts the figure is "among its images", which an SVG path satisfies without §10's render (so the test stays green while the reviewer is sent a file it cannot see), and without the declared dependency a node is dispatched ahead of the section its stated behaviour rests on.
findings.text: §6's mechanism depends on `a-review-can-see-the-figure` §10 ("The dispatch renders an SVG figure to PNG") for the sentence "an SVG reaches the reviewer as the PNG that `a-review-can-see-the-figure` §10 renders on the dispatch", but that section carries `data-status="implementable"` (unlanded), and §6 declares no dependency on it; `plan-section-depends-on` carries only `{"s18": ["scoring-should-stop-a-promotion#s6"]`

findings.reason: the plan already corrected exactly this omission in §17, so leaving the two new/changed sections without it hands a later reader no route to the gate receipt, the same defect the neighbouring sections were rewritten to close.
findings.text: §18's done-when (and §6's at :2559) name no durable path for the gate and lint logs, where §14 (:2616), §15 (:2620), §16 (:2624) and the amended §17 (:2628) each require "Every log … written under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in `EXIT=`"; §18 and §6 require only that the coordinator "runs the importer population … at merge"

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — the §6 gate `g-ssp-figure-lane` names `select_profile_backend`, which no longer exists in the tree; §17's cited run directories, `landing.json` and the "Landing or cleanup failed" refusal all resolve.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §6, §17 and §18 each name a negative control that must fail on the unfixed code (removing the figure trigger, the lock retry, or the figure read), and each measure is a test that fails at base.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: a finding — §18 and §6 name no durable directory for their gate and lint logs, where §14/§15/§16 and the amended §17 all require it.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new sections' symbols and test filenames (`test_a_landing_write_waits_out_a_held_index_lock.py`, `test_a_blocking_figure_finding_holds_promotion.py`) describe their mechanism and carry no plan label, stage name or ticket number.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §18's promotion-side mechanism is asserted to parallel an existing blocking-text-finding refusal that no promotion check implements.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §6 (a figure review dispatched on the reflex with a figure lane), §17 (the staging retry) and §18 (the figure review's verdict counts at promotion without displacing the text review) each carry one deliverable and one closeable verdict.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — §6's mechanism needs `a-review-can-see-the-figure` §10 (the SVG→PNG render) and declares no dependency on it; every other relationship is present and correct.
